texts.battery_10: Ibhethri iphansi kakhulu. Ukulandelela kubuyekezwa kancane ukonga amandla.
texts.battery_20: Ibhethri iphansi. Shaja maduze: ukulethwa kwakho kuyalandelelwa.
texts.car_voice_only: Uma ushayela: izwi kuphela. Yisho ukuthi "ukulethwa okulandelayo" noma "sekuthathiwe".
texts.last_report: Umlayezo wokugcina uthunyelwe: isitolo siyazi ukuthi ifoni yakho isizocima, nokuthi kungani.
texts.shift_off_note: Ungekho emsebenzini: akukho okwabelwanayo noma okulandelelwayo.
texts.sos_confirm: Thumela i-SOS esitolo sakho nakwabathintwa obathembayo?
texts.sos_sent: I-SOS ithunyelwe. Isitolo sakho nabathintwa obathembayo bazisiwe. Uma usengozini, shayela inombolo yezimo eziphuthumayo yendawo yakho.
texts.title: Ifoni yomgibeli yokuletha kwabasebenzi bakho
